lean.name: Formalism.L2.Pj.Core.cuspA
lean.plain: The submodule of cusp forms in the period construction
lean.note: The cusp forms here are sections on the moduli space for the indefinite unitary group at the given lift. The auxiliary lattice $M'_j$ uses the integral forms in that space, with nonnegative valuations at points over finite places.
